name: enable_cron
sql: select cron.schedule('ten287-superbet-drop-bot', '30 seconds', 'select ten287_bot.tick()') as jobid

name: cron_jobs
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname like 'ten28%' order by jobname

name: bot_cron_runs
sql: select d.status, count(*) n, max(d.end_time - d.start_time) max_took, max(left(d.return_message,200)) msg from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using (jobid) where j.jobname='ten287-superbet-drop-bot' and d.start_time > now() - interval '5 minutes' group by 1

name: startup_delivery
sql: select id, kind, delivery, created_at from ten287_bot.events order by id

name: live_alerts
sql: select id, tier, side_player, eval_at, pct_10m, open_kind, delivery, sent_at, move_delay_s from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='live' order by id

name: bet105_bot_untouched
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname='ten280-bet105-drop-bot'

name: recorder_health_15m
sql: select kind, status_code, count(*) n from ten287_rec.requests where fired_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' group by 1,2 order by 1,2
